    return '<article class="card"><div class="top '+p.c+'"><h3>'+nm+'</h3><small>'+P(p.d)+'</small><div class="price">'+p.p+'</div></div><ul>'+p.l.map(function(x,i){return '<li'+(i===0&&p.inc?' class="inc"':'')+'>'+P(x)+'</li>'}).join('')+'</ul><a class="btn" data-wa="'+msg.replace(/"/g,'&quot;')+'">'+(L==='en'?'Choose this plan':'Contratar este plan')+'</a></article>'}).join('');
}

function wire(){document.querySelectorAll('[data-wa]').forEach(function(a){var m=(L==='en'&&a.dataset.waEn)||a.dataset.wa;a.href='https://wa.me/'+(a.dataset.n||'18299451328')+'?text='+encodeURIComponent(m);a.target='_blank';a.rel='noopener'})}
function setLang(l,save){
  L=l;document.documentElement.lang=l;
  els.forEach(function(e){e.innerHTML=l==='en'?EN[e.dataset.t]:e._es});
  document.title=l==='en'?EN0.title:ES0.title;metaD.content=l==='en'?EN0.desc:ES0.desc;
  document.querySelectorAll('.lang button').forEach(function(b){b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(b.dataset.l===l))});
  cards('p-srl',SRL);cards('p-ig',IG);
  table('t2',[['Plan Básico','Basic Plan'],['Plan Premium','Premium Plan']],T2);
  table('t1',[['Básico','Basic'],['Microempresas','Small Business'],['Plan Pro','Pro Plan']],T1);
  wire();
  if(save){try{localStorage.setItem('lang',l)}catch(e){}}
}
document.querySelectorAll('.lang button').forEach(function(b){b.addEventListener('click',function(){setLang(b.dataset.l,true)})});
var init=null;try{init=localStorage.getItem('lang')}catch(e){}
if(!init)init=(navigator.language||'es').toLowerCase().indexOf('en')===0?'en':'es';
setLang(init==='en'?'en':'es',false);

(function(){
  var nav=document.querySelector('nav');
  window.addEventListener('scroll',function(){nav.classList.toggle('sc',window.scrollY>8)},{passive:true});
  if(!window.matchMedia||matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches||!('IntersectionObserver' in window))return;
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-count]').forEach(function(el){
    var end=+el.dataset.count,t0=null;
    function f(t){t0=t0||t;var p=Math.min((t-t0)/1400,1),e=1-Math.pow(1-p,3);el.textContent='RD$ '+Math.round(end*e).toLocaleString('en-US');if(p<1)requestAnimationFrame(f)}
    el.textContent='RD$ 0';setTimeout(function(){requestAnimationFrame(f)},500);
  });
  var io=new IntersectionObserver(function(es){es.forEach(function(e){
    if(!e.isIntersecting)return;var el=e.target;io.unobserve(el);el.classList.add('in');
    setTimeout(function(){el.classList.remove('rv','in');el.style.transitionDelay=''},1100);
  })},{threshold:.12});
  document.querySelectorAll('.card,.steps li,.intl,.about,section>.wrap>h2,section>.wrap>.lead,.plans+details').forEach(function(el){
    el.classList.add('rv');el.style.transitionDelay=(Array.prototype.indexOf.call(el.parentNode.children,el)%4*90)+'ms';io.observe(el);
  });
})();
</script>
